decision: From 22 Oct 2026 every family test (families.score_family, score_contrast) and the power test (power.py) use null v3: ONE random draw per market-session, shared by every variant of the family - the trade's side reversed at the same minute (sign-flip randomization of the direction) or, where the side is known before the session, the same side at one random minute. 20,000 draws, exact randomization p = (1 + draws >= observed) / (1 + draws).
why: The old placebo family drew INDEPENDENT coin flips / minutes for every variant and took the median over ~50 variants. The variants are near-copies of one signal (median pairwise correlation of their daily R 0.39-0.42 on F1, F2, F10, F11, F12), so the real family's median moves as one while the old null averaged 50 independent draws: the old null was 3.0-3.8x too narrow (null sd 0.0062-0.0159R vs 0.0227-0.0482R with shared draws) and every family p-value was too small. The old power test let the same independent draws pose as the strategy, so its 0% false-pass rate was guaranteed by construction.

F11 contrast 2014-21.verdict: VOID - the contrast passed only because of the narrow null; 76% of it (+0.104R of +0.137R) is also in the no-information twins (costs are a smaller share of R on volatile, low-gamma days), not a gamma mechanism

F12 2022-now.verdict: its own family test stands under v3; its registration rationale (F11) is void; F12 is nested in F10 (same variant, half the days) and is not independent evidence
